decisions.reason: Although this classic handle line is easy for the firm to understand and support because it is close to core capabilities, its likely overlap with many established handle ranges and its absence from later website evidence make rationalization and resource reallocation more likely.

This handle family still builds strongly on the firm's existing design, engineering and certification knowledge, and as a multi-model family it is easier to refine and position across projects than a narrower design line, so continuation remains more likely than withdrawal.

Even though the product is close to the firm's knowledge base, a single door-handle design offers limited new learning and weaker strategic fit than broader system families, so it is a plausible candidate to be replaced by newer or better-integrated ranges.

The electronic access system is highly aligned with the firm's stated move toward digital building organization and draws on its in-house R&D and related access-control expertise, so a large German firm of this type would normally retain and further develop it.
